author: 曹操
book_description: 魏武帝集 with classical Chinese as the main text and English, modern Japanese, and modern Chinese overlays.

translation_policy.scope: Complete public-domain collection, including poetry and prose.
translation_policy.wenyan: Preserve every source character, work title, order, source citation, and stanza boundary exactly.
translation_policy.en: Write accurate, literary but understandable modern English; preserve imagery, register, names, dates, and rhetorical force.
translation_policy.ja_modern: Write natural contemporary Japanese with kana and normal inflection, not kanbun or a Han-character transcription.
translation_policy.zh_modern: Write clear modern Chinese that explains the source meaning without merely paraphrasing word by word.
translation_policy.poetry: Preserve line relationships and stanza logic; do not flatten verse into unrelated fragments.
translation_policy.notes: Keep source citations distinguishable from Cao Cao's text and do not invent commentary.
